text:
Mason (10), foster placement since September.
1. No photos or videos of Mason, and nothing posted online. This is a court requirement.
2. Pickup: only me (Linda) or the agency driver with a badge. My husband Greg is not approved yet, paperwork is pending, so please don't release Mason to Greg for now.
3. Mason has anxiety and may ask the same question many times. Answer calmly each time.
4. No known allergies.
